evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies the `interfaces::Mining` methods WaitTipChanged and WaitAndCreateNewBlock.
rationale: Prevents debug assertion aborts and unintended wait_until delays caused by negative or NaN timeout arguments passed over the mining interface. As noted in the description, no current client is known to pass these values (e.g., sv2-tp enforces positive timeouts), making this defensive input hardening.
